content: Knowledge-based WSD methods rely on lexical resources like WordNet BIBREF1 and usually exploit two kinds of lexical knowledge. The gloss, which defines a word sense meaning, is first utilized in Lesk algorithm BIBREF2 and then widely taken into account in many other approaches BIBREF3, BIBREF4. Besides, structural properties of semantic graphs are mainly used in graph-based algorithms BIBREF5, BIBREF6.
